import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import jax.scipy.special as lsp


def grads(x, where):
    return jax.grad(lambda z: lsp.logsumexp(z, where=where))(x)


x1 = jnp.array([0., 0., 100.])
w1 = jnp.array([True, True, False])
g1 = grads(x1, w1)
for i in range(g1.shape[0]):
    probe('example1_grad_%d' % i, float(g1[i]))
probe('example1_nan_count', float(jnp.sum(jnp.isnan(g1))))

x2 = jnp.array([0., 0., 0., 0., 100.])
w2 = jnp.arange(5) < 4
g2 = grads(x2, w2)
for i in range(g2.shape[0]):
    probe('example2_grad_%d' % i, float(g2[i]))
probe('example2_nan_count', float(jnp.sum(jnp.isnan(g2))))
